summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue from parsed declarations plus base/initNs, with an empty algebra list); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py after prepareQuery; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py covers prepare-then-apply, reuse, initNs, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, and a no-mutation check. Nothing was run, since tests were not to be executed, so the new tests and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. Changes are uncommitted. One unchanged spot: pprintAlgebra in the DAWG debug path now receives an Update rather than a list.
